title: Name That Change Model
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI-Native Schools
description: Match each of eight school change situations to the change model that best addresses it.

learningObjectives: The learner will classify eight school change situations by the model that best addresses them, correctly placing at least seven of eight on the first attempt.
prerequisites: The eight models (Kotter, Lewin, ADKAR, Bridges, Schein, Senge, Fullan, and CBAM), from the section "The Models at a Glance" in Chapter 16.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then read the feedback and the reason
keyQuestions: Teachers are grieving the loss of a familiar role. Which model?
Scores fell before they rose and leaders are worried. Which model expects this?
commonMisconceptions: One model fits every change problem
The models compete and only one is right
A model for individuals can be used to diagnose a culture
assessmentOpportunities: Teachers are grieving the loss of a familiar role. Which model?
Scores fell before they rose and leaders are worried. Which model expects this?
Can a model for individuals, such as ADKAR, diagnose a whole culture?
Is one model right for every change problem?

controls.name: 8 choice buttons
controls.description: Choose one of the models; two tries per situation.

controls.name: Show questions
controls.description: Opens a table of the models and their meanings.

controls.name: Previous missed, Next missed
controls.description: On the results screen, page through the missed items.

controls.name: Play again
controls.description: Reshuffles the items for a practice run.
